query: Find the current exchange rates of USD to EUR, USD to JPY, and USD to GBP. Then tell me which currency gives the most value per dollar.
description: Parallel fan-out with 3 independent researcher nodes, one per currency pair
validation_notes: Wall-clock of the researcher layer must be ≤ max branch elapsed, not sum

query: Find the current market capitalisation of Apple, Microsoft, and Google (Alphabet). Rank them from largest to smallest.
description: Parallel fan-out with 3 researcher nodes for market cap data
validation_notes: Researchers for all three companies should run concurrently

query: Fetch https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ada_Lovelace and extract her birth year, death year, and main contribution to computing.
description: Critic auto-inserted after Distiller; structured fields clearly present in source — expect pass verdict
validation_notes: Critic should pass because birth year, death year, and contribution are clearly on the Wikipedia page

query: Fetch https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ada_Lovelace and extract her birth year, death year, her father's full name, and her exact birthplace address. The distiller output must contain all four fields — the critic should fail if the birthplace address is missing.
description: Critic should fail because a street-level birthplace address is not available on the Wikipedia page
validation_notes: Exact street address is not on the Wikipedia page; Distiller cannot extract it; Critic should emit fail and trigger recovery

query: Calculate how much $10,000 invested at 7% annual interest compounded monthly would grow to after 20 years. Show the final amount and total interest earned.
description: Pure computation — no web research needed; Planner should route directly to Coder
validation_notes: Expected: ~$38,697 final amount, ~$28,697 interest. No Researcher node should appear.

query: Compute the first 15 Fibonacci numbers and find which one is closest to 500.
description: Computation over a well-defined sequence — should use Coder + SandboxExecutor
validation_notes: 377 and 610 are the Fibonacci numbers closest to 500; the code should identify one of them

query: Search the web for recent user reviews of the iPhone 16 and analyse the overall sentiment. Are customers mostly positive, negative, or mixed about it?
description: Researcher fetches reviews; sentiment_analyser classifies the aggregated findings
validation_notes: sentiment_analyser node must appear in the graph; output must include a sentiment label

query: Fetch https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Climate_change and analyse the sentiment of the opening content. Is the language alarming, neutral, or optimistic?
description: Researcher fetches the article; sentiment_analyser classifies the tone
validation_notes: Wikipedia climate change article uses measured/neutral encyclopaedic language; expect neutral or mixed
